mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances when RSAFS decreases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, which is generally positive for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a tightening labor market, which is positive for economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals stagflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and CPIAUCSL MoM increase > 0.5%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when GDPC1 grows by less than 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.
